page.overview:
Who is Chronodile?

Chronodile is a minor villain who fought with Darkwing.

In 2004, Chronodile fought with Darkwing and injured him badly enough that he was still healing when the Guardians of the Globe fought with the Lizard League causing him to not join the battle.
